summary: Backdated credit reduction after hourly smoothing policy change resulting in negative invoice adjustment request
description:
Issue summary:
NeuroDocs reports a ~$3,240.75 unexpected credit reduction on their invoice after a platform change to the hourly smoothing policy. Credits appear to have been reapplied backdated across multiple hourly windows for 2026-03-07, producing a negative adjustment on the finalized invoice INV-2026-03-07-9921.

Impact:
- Customer invoice shows a negative line item and a reduced credit balance; finance & procurement are escalating.
- Affects live usage for the org during a critical billing period; customer requests rapid remediation and an explanation.

Environment:
- Redwood hosted (prod) region: us-east-1
- Customer tier: enterprise (dedicated support)
- Affected models: gpt-redwood-3b, embedding-redwood-v1

Observed behavior:
- On 2026-03-07 00:00–04:00 UTC platform smoothing policy recalculation ran and created a set of backdated adjustments.
- Postback entries show hourly windows reclassified from "smoothed" to "unsmoothed" leading to credit delta that was applied retroactively.

Expected behavior:
- Smoothing policy change should only apply forward from rollout time, not retroactively modify finalized invoice windows.

Attachments/IDs:
- Invoice: INV-2026-03-07-9921
- Customer org id: org_54412

Notes: customer provided CSV of invoice lines and example request IDs in comments.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Identify hourly smoothing policy change deployment on 2026-03-07 (deployment id: deploy/smoothing/2026-03-07-02).
2) Run reconciliation job for org_54412 for window 2026-03-07 00:00–05:00 UTC (same job as billing-postback-recon v2).
3) Observe credit adjustments applied to finalized invoice rows and compare pre/post smoothing flags in the hourly accumulator table.
logs:
Sample log snippets (anonymized):
[2026-03-07T02:01:12Z] scheduler: started smoothing-recalc job for window=2026-03-07T00:00:00Z
[2026-03-07T02:01:18Z] metering: marked window=2026-03-07T01:00:00Z as unsmoothed (prev=smoothed) org=org_54412 delta_tokens=-41234
[2026-03-07T02:01:25Z] billing: provisional_credit_adjustment queued invoice=INV-2026-03-07-9921 amount=-3240.75
[2026-03-07T02:05:03Z] postback: outbound_postback org=org_54412 status=200 id=pb_7783
investigation:
Initial hypothesis: the smoothing policy migration script accidentally included a backfill path that updated previously finalized hourly accumulator rows.
Queries run:
- SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hourly_accumulator WHERE org_id='org_54412' AND window >= '2026-03-07' AND smoothing_flag != prev_smoothing_flag;
- Reconciled postback order vs. invoice line timestamps for pb_7783 and related ids.
Findings so far:
- 42 hourly rows were toggled from smoothed->unsmoothed for org_54412 during the migration window.
- Postback ordering remained in chronological order; the credit application path treated toggled rows as new deltas and added adjustments to an already-finalized invoice.
- Related PR that deployed the change: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4823 (feature: hourly-smoothing-config)
comments: [NeuroDocs - 2026-03-10] Hi Redwood support - our March 7 invoice shows a negative credit adjustment of $3,240.75 applied to a finalized invoice. We did not request retroactive changes. Please advise and restore prior balance.
[Maya Patel - 2026-03-10] Acknowledged. Escalating to billing & SRE. Assigned to Anika Shah. Initial triage: collecting logs, invoice lines, and postback CSV from the customer.

[Anika Shah - 2026-03-10] Triage complete. Re-running reconciliation for org_54412 in a replay environment to reproduce. Noted smoothing migration ran at 02:01 UTC on 2026-03-07. Marking as P1 due to invoice impact.

[SRE Team - 2026-03-11] Investigation: found migration script included `--backfill` flag in one region; script altered historical smoothing flags. Filed hotfix PR to stop backfill and prevent future auto-application: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4830

[Billing Ops - 2026-03-11] Hold: pending confirmation of correct credit recalculation. If confirmed, we'll issue a credit memo and reapply customer balance. Tentative adjustment scheduled for 2026-03-12 10:00 UTC.
[NeuroDocs - 2026-03-12] Thank you - please confirm whether this will change our outstanding balance and when we can expect corrected invoice PDF.

[Anika Shah - 2026-03-12] Resolution planned: apply manual reversal of the backdated adjustments for org_54412, generate credit memo CM-2026-03-12-221, and reissue invoice PDF. Billing ops to confirm when complete.
resolution_notes: Pending: manual reversal scheduled and credit memo CM-2026-03-12-221 to be issued. Hotfix PR merged to prevent backfill behavior and a follow-up checklist created to add canary checks for smoothing migrations. Billing ops to confirm completion and send corrected invoice PDF to customer.
customer_requested_outcome: Restore original credit balance and reissue corrected invoice PDF; root cause explanation and assurance that smoothing changes will not be applied retroactively without explicit consent.
follow_up_tasks: Add canary test for smoothing migration to prevent backfill
Update runbook to forbid auto-backfill for finalized invoices
Billing: apply manual reversal and issue CM-2026-03-12-221
Engineering: add telemetry to detect retroactive accumulator changes
